source_refs.note: Topic 1.11 Network Diagnostic Tools and Commands as printed up to its first sub-heading (PDF 17-18, printed 12-13); the sub-headings are their own lessons.

blocks.text: Network diagnostic tools are used to find network problems. They help check internet and network connections. These tools show whether devices can communicate properly. Commands are entered using the command prompt or terminal. It helps identify slow or broken connections.

Network troubleshooting is done to find and fix network issues. It helps detect connection and speed problems. Troubleshooting checks cables, devices, and settings. It reduces network downtime and errors. It helps maintain smooth communication. Proper troubleshooting improves network performance.
